provenance.citation: Copied from version A of this game: NutritionGame, commit f847454, src/data/scenarios.json. Values and citations as written there; not checked independently against the original sources.

description.es: Arma un almuerzo equilibrado apuntando a un tercio de las ingestas diarias de referencia FAO/OMS para una mujer adulta (19–50 años). Combina granos cocidos, tubérculos, legumbres, maní y frutas frescas. Observa cómo los rendimientos de cocción y los datos faltantes influyen en tu puntaje.
description.en: Build a balanced lunch targeting one-third of FAO/WHO daily reference intakes for an adult woman (19–50 y). Combine cooked grains, tubers, legumes, nuts and fresh fruits. Watch how cooking yields and missing data affect your balance.

source.citation: Version A of this game sets this meal to one third of the daily reference intakes (NutritionGame commit f847454, src/data/scenarios.json, mealFraction). It is a design choice; no external source is cited.
